model.execution_path: Claude Code in VS Code on the owner's laptop, Workflow tool subagents
model.execution_notes: Subagents inherit the session model. Their system prompt and the repository instructions the harness injects (the engine checkout's CLAUDE.md, which imports AGENTS.md, at 5f0b5150 on main, the session's project directory) are outside this pilot's control; prompt hashes cover only the user-turn prompt. The workflow scripts run from the run directory inside the session scratchpad worktree, which the Workflow tool accepts, so no copy of the scripts is needed.

Note: design.json's harness_version (2, the pilot scripts' version) is a different field from this Claude Code version string.

seed_provenance.file_note: Seed cases for the stimulus-generation pilot, converted from the engine's hand-built dataset (data/measured/imported_pairs.json, 27 pairs; the ones whose two prompts differ in a single span are kept). The text is unaltered, intentional misspellings included. specialty and swap_type are labels only (they enter no estimand; HANDOFF.md assumption 1) and are left 'unlabelled' for the owner to fill. Holdout seal check over this file: CLEAN.

input_refactors.reason: PR #69 Codex P1 finding 4163704150 (concrete example vocabulary in the version-2 generation template): the example words of the template's rules moved into design.json (prompt_examples; rule 7's list of probe endings renders from probe_endings) and render through markers, following the precedent of commit 9a2aab20, where the example negative control moved from the template into design.json on PR #52. Every one of the 18 rendered prompts is byte-identical, so no prompt a subagent received changed.
